cohort: The participants were women who received induction of labor at public hospitals in Kembata Zone, central Ethiopia, whose medical charts were retrospectively reviewed.
finding: The prevalence of failed labor induction was 21.2%, with maternal age over 30 years, primigravida status, a low Bishop score, and premature rupture of membranes identified as significant contributing factors.
cross-section timing: Data was extracted from medical charts of past inductions.
